description: Empirical specific-methane-yield lookup per feedstock with a temperature de-rating curve. Numbers reused from EC140 F1a + EC141/EC142 feedstock DBs.
source: Buswell & Mueller (1952); Batstone et al. (2002) IWA ADM1; Labatut et al. (2011)

Y_max_m3_kgVS.note: Max specific methane yield (datasheet rated point)

feedstock_table.comment: Specific CH4 yield (m3 CH4 / kg VS destroyed) at mesophilic optimum, per feedstock.

temperature_curve.comment: Yield multiplier vs temperature (degC). Peak 1.0 at 37 C, drops outside mesophilic band.
